cases.title: Flagrant hit, ejection
cases.where: El Latigo Shredders at Tengus City Terrors, week 15
cases.text:
Officials ejected Nobuo Lanxu (DL, Terrors) with 6:13 left in the second quarter for a hit on Alfie Gyejide (QB, Shredders) that drew a roughing the passer flag. Alfie Gyejide (QB, Shredders) left for a few plays and returned. Lanxu sought out Gyejide after the game to apologize. The league's film review found the contact was avoidable. It was the second flag of that kind against the Terrors in the game.

The players' union has been notified.

cases.title: Benches empty after a late hit
cases.where: Port Logan Commodores at Diamond City Dynamos, week 15
cases.text:
Players from both teams poured onto the field in the second quarter after an exchange between Selloviy Normeniy (Dynamos) and Tomas Fonchamp (Commodores). Officials ejected four players in total.

The league office has asked both clubs for statements.

cases.title: Confrontation with a fan
cases.where: Wolford Dragons at Holliday Beetles, week 15
cases.text:
Georgia Yenteniy (QB, Beetles) threw a towel at a fan who was heckling him after the game. Video of the exchange circulated on social media. There was no physical contact.

The Beetles say the player was provoked.
